question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Public enemy number one

options.text: Someone who is the greatest threat to a group or community

solution:
The correct answer is **"Someone who is the greatest threat to a group or community."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "public enemy number one"** refers to a person or group that is considered the greatest threat to a community or society. (कोई व्यक्ति या समूह जिसे किसी समुदाय या समाज के लिए सबसे बड़ा खतरा माना जाता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *In many countries today, drug abuse is **public enemy number one**__.*
 
 
 
• This phrase is often used in the context of law enforcement, where a criminal or terrorist may be labeled as** "public enemy number one"** due to the danger they pose to the public.
 
• The term** "public enemy"** originally referred to a person who was wanted by law enforcement for a crime, but has since evolved to encompass a broader range of threats to society.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
